officialName: To Be Submitted by a Small Entity / Startup / Educational Institution
purpose: Declare and prove status as a small entity, a startup, or an educational institution — the status that determines reduced official fees.

fee.note: No fee is printed on the face of Form 28; the form establishes the fee-reduced status applied to the related application/patent.

layout.notes: Two-column table with four numbered rows. Form 28 prints NO 'To, The Controller ... at' addressee — it is filed with/attached to the related application. Section 2 is a static reference of the evidence required per status (reproduced as boilerplate, with the proof document declared as a required attachment).

sections.title: 1. Name, address and nationality of the applicant/patentee and status claimed
sections.description: Pre-printed: 'I/We ... applicant/patentee in respect of the patent application no ... or patent no ... hereby declare that I/we am/are a small entity in accordance with rule 2(fa) or a startup in accordance with rule 2(fb) or an educational institution in accordance with rule 2(ca) and submit the following document(s) as proof:'

autofill.derivation: Choose 'I' for a single declarant, 'We' for multiple.

fields.label: Name, address and nationality of the applicant/patentee
fields.helpText: Full name (family/principal name first), complete address incl postal index no./code and state, and nationality.

validation.message: Enter the declarant's name, address and nationality.

validation.patternMessage: Enter the application or patent number.

fields.label: Status claimed
fields.description: Retain the applicable status (the printed clause offers all three as alternatives).

options.label: a small entity in accordance with rule 2(fa)
a startup in accordance with rule 2(fb)
an educational institution in accordance with rule 2(ca)

autofill.derivation: Suggest from the applicant category recorded on Form 1 §3B (small entity / startup / educational institution); the user confirms.

fields.text: and submit the following document(s) as proof:

sections.title: 2. Documents to be submitted
sections.description: Static reference of the evidence required per claimed status. Reproduced verbatim; the applicable proof document is declared as a required attachment (see attachments).

fields.text:
(i) Small entity: (Indian applicant) evidence of registration under the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006 (27 of 2006); (foreign entity) any other document.
(ii) Startup: any document as evidence of eligibility, as defined in rule 2(fb); (foreign entity) any other document.
(iii) Educational institution: any document as evidence of eligibility, as defined in rule 2(ca); (foreign educational institution) any other document.
The information provided herein is correct to the best of my/our knowledge and belief.

autofill.derivation: Default to the preparation / signing date; editable.

sections.title: To be signed by the applicant(s)/patentee(s)/authorized registered patent agent.
4. Name of the natural person who has signed

fields.label: Name of the natural person who has signed

validation.message: Enter the full name of the natural person who signed.

attachments.label: Evidence of the claimed status (small entity / startup / educational institution) per the reference in Section 2
attachments.note: The proof document must match the claimed status and whether the applicant is Indian or a foreign entity.

notes: Note. - Strike out whichever is not applicable (applicant/patentee, am/are, patent application no/patent no, and the status clause — retain only the claimed status).
Form 28 prints no addressee block; it is filed with/attached to the related application.
The claimed status should be consistent with Form 1 §3B (category of applicant).

printedHeader.statute: THE PATENTS ACT, 1970 (39 of 1970) and THE PATENTS RULES, 2003
printedHeader.subject: TO BE SUBMITTED BY A SMALL ENTITY / STARTUP / EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTION
